label: CLAIM_CONFORMANCE
note: CLAIM_CONFORMANCE checks against the local READ_MODEL_QUERIES consumer rehearsal (CapitalService.read_query over the in-process loopback facade). Results are SIMULATED, fixture_mode REFERENCE_IN_MEMORY. This is not a read model, not ReadObservationV1, and not SEMANTIC_CONFORMANCE. Visibility classes, paging and list_* queries are UNDETERMINED upstream and not implemented. The credit_claim row for a valid fixture id depends on a draw: the mock credit ledger notes a claim only then. Keyset rows pin the key lists of sections 2.11 to 2.13; the drift script re-derives them from the draft working tree. A missing protocol checkout is SKIPPED and is not a pass. The original 39 mapped GET /api/state, CreditMachine.view and CreditMachine.view_claim checks are retained under the same draft revision, with original_pinned_sha recording their earlier citation. Their per-read guard also checks the overlay state digest.

claims.claim: The mock claim view reports snapshot_frozen true.
A valid fixture id is UNKNOWN_CLAIM until a draw notes a claim in the mock credit ledger.
A CAPTURED fixture settlement carries the nested mock claim. Fixtures hold no earlier phase, so the null branch is not reachable through the routes.
The nested settlement claim provenance is MOCK_SETTLEMENT_ONLY.
An absent id on get_credit_advance is UNKNOWN_ADVANCE.
A padded id on get_credit_advance is INVALID_ID, not an unknown id.
An absent id on get_credit_claim is UNKNOWN_CLAIM.
A padded id on get_credit_claim is INVALID_ID, not an unknown id.
An absent id on get_settlement is UNKNOWN_SETTLEMENT.
A padded id on get_settlement is INVALID_ID, not an unknown id.
Across all three queries and unknown, empty, padded and over-long ids, the only error codes are INVALID_ID, UNKNOWN_ADVANCE, UNKNOWN_CLAIM, UNKNOWN_SETTLEMENT.

The envelope fixture_mode is REFERENCE_IN_MEMORY.
query_digest is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the query name and id. The draft names no algorithm; this is a Capital choice.

accepted_through on get_credit_claim equals the length of the credit machine journal.

None of the seven RESERVED_FOR ReadObservationV1 names appears in the envelope or a body.

Each body equals the pinned reader output unchanged: the envelope adds keys around it, never inside it.

claim_id cites the bound mock settlement fixture.
trade_id echoes the bound fixture's synthetic trade id.
currency is the fixture's KRW label.
amount is the synthetic draw amount in fixture units.
beneficiary_role is the fixture's organizer role (the section-6 owner-or-holder class).
open_face is the bound claim's gross face in fixture units.
reserved_open is the mock ledger integer the draw reserved, not a bank reservation.
residual_unreserved is open_face minus reserved_open on the mock ledger.
confirmed_cash_on_face is the committed statement cash on the bound face.
recovery_due_on_face is zero on the fixture with no recovery posture.
snapshot_frozen is true because a bound mock claim exists.
outstanding_exposure equals the drawn exposure before any repay.
draw_id is the diagnostic pair derived from the draw idempotency key.
settlement_gate is the MOCK_COMMIT_OBSERVED label, not an atomic proof.
note_status is the mock ledger's NOTED state after the draw.
funds_executed stays false on the read view.
repayment_observed stays false before any repay command.
kyc_executed stays false; the read is not KYC.
underwriting_executed stays false; the read is not underwriting.
interest_defined stays false; the mock defines no interest.
A missing advance id reads UNKNOWN_ADVANCE and adds no new error code.
The claim view provenance is MOCK_CREDIT_F04_ONLY.
claim_id names the bound mock claim object, a different object from the section-2.11 settlement claim.
open_face on the claim view is the mock face in fixture units.
reserved_open on the claim view is the mock ledger integer the advance reserved.
residual_unreserved on the claim view is the unreserved remainder.
confirmed_cash_on_face on the claim view is the committed statement cash.
recovery_due_on_face on the claim view is zero on the fixture.
snapshot_frozen on the mock claim view is always true; it is not a chain snapshot.
The claim view carries the same always-false flags; funds_executed stays false.
The claim view has no lifecycle_authority key; the two objects are not merged into one schema.
A missing claim id reads UNKNOWN_CLAIM and adds no new error code.
The GET /api/state read leaves canonical_state, journal length, the overlay state digest and operation_count unchanged.
The advance view read writes no journal entry, stores no idempotency key and changes no counter.
The claim view read also leaves the bound ownership source's canonical_state unchanged, like the existing view _guard.
Even erroring reads (missing advance, missing claim) leave the guard unchanged.
